title: The Null Dimension
description: A dimension where Minecraft doesn't seem so... normal.
body: This mod adds a brand new dimension, The Null. You can enter The Null by crafting a Null Diamond, made with an Ender Pearl and a Diamond. Upon right clicking it, as long as you are in the Overworld, when you right click you will be teleported into The Null. In The Null, you will find strange trees, mountains made of Null Blocks, as well as Plains Villages. Sometimes, you may find a resident of The Null, known as the empty. They are hostile, but empty, and so when they get close enough to you, they turn into nothing. This new world creates an interesting adventure.
